notes: §1985:XIV.3.4.4 GR3: "The content of the status key data item and the content of the error key data item (if applicable) of the area referenced by cd-name-1 are updated by the MCS", per Tables 1 and 2. MessageControlSession.Purge sets error keys 0/1/2/4 per destination and status 00/10/20/30/70/80, Statement writes the status into the area and Emit stores the area back; an input-output CD has no error key. The witness reads 00/0 and 70/4. Probes at 85: (b) partial to D1, disabled D2, D3: PURGE count 2 gives 10 '02'; unknown ZZ 20 '1'; D3 + ZZ 20 '01'; disabled D2 + ZZ + D1 80 '210'; (a/f) count 0 30; I-O CD with no portion 70, with one 00; no mcs.json 20 '1'; (c) refused COBOL0902 at 2014/2023.

The 2023 candidates cover only file I-O status, the cursor locator and overlapping operands. The PURGE statement and the Communication module are absent, so the rule is dropped.
